Jordan — thanks for the quick note and great questions. Per our call, all three deployment modes are options for MediCore depending on final security needs and scale: Hosted API (fastest onboarding), Dedicated GPU pools (reserved capacity with data isolation), and Private (VPC / on-prem for strict compliance).

I attached a short PoC SOW (RWI_PoC_SOW_v1.pdf) and a one-page security architecture sketch. High-level PoC idea below — I'll send a more detailed timeline once you confirm the target success criteria:

- Objective: Validate latency under production-like patient payloads, end-to-end PHI handling, and cost/per-token economics for the target throughput (10–50 concurrent clinicians).
- Duration: 4–6 weeks (we typically propose 4 weeks for initial functional validation + 2 weeks ramp if Dedicated/Private infra is required).
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 350ms for typical requests; KV prefix caching reduces per-token cost by >=25%; security checklist items (SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, audit logs) are validated.
- Stakeholders we need from MediCore: Clinical PM (you), Security lead (recommended Sara), Cloud/Infra contact for network/VPC peering, and a product owner for integration tests.
- Deployment options for PoC:
  * Hosted: fastest — we can start within 48–72 hours and run the functional validation.
  * Dedicated: deploy a reserved pool (single-tenant) in your cloud region — ~1 week lead time for allocation.
  * Private (VPC): requires network setup and possibly an on-prem package — typical lead 3–4 weeks depending on procurement and firewall rules.

Next steps I propose: you confirm preferred route (fastest to validate feature surface: Hosted; closest to production parity: Dedicated; strict isolation: Private). Once decided, I’ll share a tight PoC timeline with milestones and a kickoff invite.

If helpful I can also loop in our Solutions Architect (Vivek) and our Security Liaison (Rafael) to go over the security checklist directly with Sara.

Cheers,

Quick estimates below (OOM) — assumptions: 4 GPU equivalents, moderate concurrent usage (10–50), 6-week pilot. I'll refine numbers if they want a committed Dedicated contract longer term.

- Hosted (pilot only): $4k–$8k total for 6 weeks (usage billed per token; no infra setup). Fastest to start (48–72h).
- Dedicated (reserved pilot pool): one-time setup + validation: ~$12k; monthly run-rate for pilot (pro-rated) ~$6k–$9k depending on burst settings and region. Dedicated gives predictable latency and isolation at the compute layer; we keep customer data isolated in the tenant but keys are still RWI-managed unless we enable BYOK.
- Private (VPC + BYOK): one-time onboarding & network/setup: ~$25k–$40k (depends on firewall/VPN work); monthly run-rate: $10k–$18k for the same capacity. Requires procurement/IT signoff for peering and KMS.

Lead times: Hosted: 48–72h; Dedicated: ~7–10 business days to provision and smoke test; Private (VPC/BYOK): 3–4 weeks (network setup, KMS configuration, customer testing).

Risks: BYOK adds extra lead time (HSM approvals), and Private deployments sometimes require additional certs on their side.

Happy to join a call with Sara next week.

—Vivek
